Full summary: Shipped 2.13.0 (relation-dedup hardening) / plugin 1.31.0: fix commit 161515b reviewed clean by two adversarial verifiers, tag v2.13.0 pushed, CI Publish running. Field memo updated to the 2.8.0-2.13.0 range with the dedup row and follow-up list trimmed.
Decisions: Chose minor bumps (server 2.13.0, plugin 1.31.0) for the dedup hardening release — the pass gained new report fields (skipped_id_collisions, failed_groups, errors, relation_dedup_error), an additive surface change, matching the 2.11/2.12 minor-per-feature pattern.; Chose to update the existing wave-2 memo in place (range retitled 2.8.0-2.13.0, dedup row added, relation-upsert retirement bullet now points at the shipped pass, UNIQUE backstop stays on the follow-up list) over drafting a separate 2.13.0 memo — the memo's STATUS gate is version-based and the field has not yet acted on it, so one cumulative memo is one upgrade action.
Findings: 2.13.0 ship state mid-flight: tag pushed, CI Publish watch running in background; still pending after publish confirms — plugin pin update in BOTH user and project scopes (stale project pin shadows user scope), ship-state + memo commit, push
